hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds an afterInitialize permission but performs no logic in that callback. Pool initialization state (initialTick, poolInitialized) is tracked via the separate externally-callable initializePools() function, which calls a liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-ops.
